# MoniTabs

> MoniTabs is a free Android app to track who owes you money, what you owe others, and your monthly income and expenses. No account needed; entries are stored on your phone. Free with ads. Made by Meinua Labs.

## Facts
- Platform: Android (Google Play). No iOS or web version.
- Price: free, with ads. A short rewarded video removes ads for 6 hours. No subscription.
- Account: none. No sign-up, no email. Entries are stored in a database on the phone; there is no cloud sync.
- Internet: the app works offline. Ads and (only with the user's consent) analytics use the internet.
- Debts: "They Owe" and "I Owe" tabs, partial payments, borrow more, settle in full, one-time reminders at a chosen date and time.
- Wallet tab: income and expenses per month, with a note per month, a calendar view and a year view.
- Wallet categories, inspired by the 50/30/20 budgeting rule: spending is split into Needs, Wants, and Debts & Savings; income into Active, Passive, and Debts & Other.
- Custom labels: users create their own labels inside each category (for example "Rent" under Needs or "Coffee" under Wants).
- Charts: donut (pie) charts for income and spending, and a summary with the percent for every category and label.
- Currencies: multiple currencies; totals are grouped per currency.
- Wallet export: monthly and yearly reports as PDF and Excel.
- Debt export: a PDF for a debt, to share with the other person.
- Backup and restore to a .monitabs file, plus an optional automatic local backup.
- Other: privacy mode (one tap hides amounts on the main screens), a calculator inside amount fields, and an optional daily reminder to log the day (off by default).
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian.
